title: whatsapp sessions._id (= bare hash of groupJid:ownerUserId) and its turns._id (sha256 of sessionId:messageId) are still not tenant-scoped
evidence: apps/api/src/whatsapp/store.ts used sessionId = source._id; with the source _id now tenant-scoped the session id is kept as the bare source.hash so chunks/claims/evidence/citations (which cite sessionId) and the turn ids (derived from sessionId, messageId not stored on the turn so they cannot be recomputed in a migration) do not change. sessions._id therefore stays globally unique across tenants for whatsapp. The owner id is bound to one tenant, so a real collision needs the same groupJid and ownerUserId under two tenants.
fix_direction: Approver decision: whether session ids are public identifiers (citations, URLs) and may be rewritten; if yes, a second migration must rewrite sessions._id, turns.sessionId, turns._id (needs messageId), chunks.sourceRef, claims/decisions/session_pages/speakers evidence.sessionId, tree_index sessionRef.
